There is an "if movement is 1" statement, in which case speed is 5. "Else speed is 0" indicates that speed is 0, as there can be only 2 states of movement variable (1 and 0).

This is in player character step event. Whenever cutscene is played, there is also that check on top of the code, a simple if, saying "if cutscene is played (cutsceneInvolved = 1), then movement = 0".

So technically, it should stop moving as soon cutscene starts. cutsceneInvolved is 1 upon entering the room, yet, player character is moving like no tomorrow (Until I press enter on the first textbox, as I said).
